gloss_en: marriage/marital union (nisu'in) — conjugal joining as a spiritual archetype in Likutey Moharan I:7, where receiving counsel (etzah) from another is likened to marital union and receiving seed (the kidneys that counsel being the vessels of procreation); holy union with tzaddikim vs. 'marriage in the kelipah' with the wicked, as in the serpent's counsel to Eve (hishi'ani as leshon nisu'in)
